_source: MH3U US v1.3 RPX: u32[221] at 0x101EBE5C -> up to 3 x 30-byte candidates (em u8, pad, u16 x 14). The EU v1.3 RPX holds byte-identical lists.

fields.weight: chance of being picked, of 100 (every list sums to 100)
fields.min_star: only picked once the progress value is >= this: sUserData+0x5A58 for hub quests, sQuest+0xA5A for village quests, the room's value online. Tracks star rank in the game's own quests (read as 'needs this star unlocked'; not confirmed in-game)
fields.Nando_hp..Stamina: copied into the invader's monster block (same meaning as the quest's monster fields)
fields.x18: unknown (zenny-sized, e.g. Deviljho 16800; maybe a hunt bonus)
